lines.text: Tuned below their hearing. Is that all? ...That is all.
It is done. I wrote it down. I will not forget the quiet.
The pylon is dark. I am logging a fault. I am also logging that I did not see anything.

choice.text: Let me read your margin notes. They matter.
Keep your notes. I did not hear any of this.

lines.text: ...They are in the appendix. Appendix C. Nobody reads Appendix C.
Understood. Thank you. For the nothing.
